header.title: Modal
header.description: Dialog window that appears over the page with a dimmed backdrop. While open, the rest of the page cannot be used: focus stays inside the modal until it closes. By default it closes with Escape, a backdrop click or the × button. Use it to confirm actions, fill short forms or show information that needs attention. For long or non-blocking content, a `Drawer` or a separate page works better.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and open the modal to see the result. If you turn off `closeOnBackdrop`, `closeOnEscape` and `showClose` together, it only closes from the footer button.

texts.title: Order details
texts.subtitle: Order #1042
texts.body: The order is being prepared and will ship within the next 24 hours.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Control the modal with `open` and `onOpenChange`. `title` and `subtitle` build the header, `children` the body and `footer` the footer with the actions. Pass a translated `closeLabel` in other languages: the × button is announced as "Close" by default.

texts.title: Discard draft
texts.subtitle: This action cannot be undone
texts.body: The current draft will be deleted. You can start a new one anytime.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` sets the width and padding: `sm` (22rem), `md` (28rem, default), `lg` (36rem), `xl` (44rem) and `full`, which fills the viewport minus a margin. On small screens it never exceeds the available width.

texts.title: Size
texts.body: The width comes from the --gem-modal-width variable, which each size redefines.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: `radius` uses the radius tokens (`sm`, `md`, `lg`). `rounded` rounds more: `true` uses `--gem-radius-2xl`, a number is a percentage and a string is any CSS value. `bordered` and `shadow` control the border and shadow.

texts.title: Appearance
texts.body: Each button opens the modal with a different combination of visual props.

compound.title: Compound sections
compound.description: When every child is `Modal.Header`, `Modal.Body` or `Modal.Footer`, the modal uses them as-is instead of building the sections from props. Useful when the body needs its own classes or more structure. The × button is still added to the header. In this mode the modal does not take its name from the title on its own: connect them with `headingId` and `aria-labelledby`.

texts.title: Workspace settings
texts.subtitle: Personal plan
texts.body: Compound sections keep the markup explicit when the body is more than a paragraph.
texts.hint: Modal.Body accepts className and any div attribute.

form.title: Form
form.description: On open, focus goes to the first focusable element that is not the ×, here the email field. The submit button lives in the footer, outside the `<form>`, and connects through the `form` attribute.

texts.title: Invite member
texts.subtitle: They will receive an email with access

scrollable.title: Long content
scrollable.description: The modal has a max height (90% of the viewport, up to 44rem). When content does not fit, only the body scrolls: the header and footer stay put.

texts.title: Release notes
texts.subtitle: Header and footer stay put
texts.paragraph: The body scrolls while the header and footer stay visible, so the actions are always at hand.

persistent.title: No automatic dismiss
persistent.description: With `closeOnBackdrop={false}`, `closeOnEscape={false}` and `showClose={false}` the modal only closes from a footer action. Use it carefully, for decisions that cannot be left halfway.

texts.title: Transfer ownership
texts.subtitle: This action cannot be undone
texts.body: The new owner receives billing, members and workspace settings immediately.

initialFocus.title: Initial focus
initialFocus.description: `initialFocusRef` picks which element gets focus on open. In destructive confirmations, focus the safe option (Cancel) instead of the first control, so a hasty Enter deletes nothing.

texts.title: Delete file
texts.subtitle: annual-report.pdf
texts.body: The file moves to the trash and is permanently deleted in 30 days.

draggable.title: Draggable
draggable.description: With `draggable` the modal moves by dragging its header. Buttons, links and fields in the header keep working. The modal stays inside the viewport and returns to the center each time it opens.

texts.title: Notes
texts.subtitle: Drag the header to move it
texts.body: Useful when the modal covers page information you need to check.

nestedContent.title: Components inside
nestedContent.description: Components with floating menus, like `Select` and `DatePicker`, work inside the modal and their menus show on top. `Tabs` helps organize long forms without growing the modal.

texts.title: Project setup
texts.subtitle: Nested components
texts.intro: Open the select or the calendar: the menu appears above the modal.

nested.title: Modal over modal
nested.description: A modal can open another. The second stacks on top and Escape or a backdrop click close the top one first. If you close the bottom one, close the top one too.

texts.outerBody: Destructive actions can open a second confirmation modal. The first one stays mounted until the second closes.

tailwind.title: Welcome
tailwind.subtitle: Borderless with a blurred backdrop
tailwind.body: classNames adds classes to each part. With Tailwind's backdrop: variant you can also style the backdrop.

cva.title: Modal with variants
cva.body: The wrapper applies the cva variants to className and passes the rest of the props through.

css.title: Branded modal
css.subtitle: Tokens redefined in a class
css.body: The class changes the width with --gem-modal-width and redefines the color and radius tokens only inside this modal.

header.title: Modal API
header.description: API reference for the Modal React component: props, sections, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath. The sections are available as `Modal.Header`, `Modal.Body` and `Modal.Footer`, and as standalone exports.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of a <dialog> (DialogHTMLAttributes<HTMLDialogElement>, except title and open) and passes them to the element, like ref. classNames adds classes to each part: root, header, title, subtitle, extra, body, footer and close.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.dialog: It is a native <dialog> opened with showModal(): the browser puts it in the top layer and makes the rest of the page inert. It has aria-modal="true".
a11y.name: With title, the modal takes its name from the title (aria-labelledby). With compound sections, connect the Modal.Header headingId to aria-labelledby. Without a title, pass aria-label.
a11y.focus: On open, focus goes to initialFocusRef or, if missing, to the first focusable element that is not the × button.
a11y.trap: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle only through the modal elements.
a11y.restore: On close, focus returns to the element that had it before opening, usually the button that opened the modal.
a11y.dismiss: Escape closes the modal (unless closeOnEscape={false}). With nested modals, it closes only the top one.
a11y.scroll: While open, it locks page scroll with overflow: hidden on <body>.
a11y.labels: The × button is named "Close" by default. Pass a translated closeLabel in other languages.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.radius: Radius based on `radius` when there is no `rounded`.
rules.roundedCustom: Custom radius from `--gem-modal-radius` when `rounded` is a number or a string.
rules.draggable: Applied with `draggable`. Changes the header cursor.
rules.headerSolo: Header without subtitle. It has no styles of its own; it is a hook.
rules.heading: Wrapper for the title and subtitle.
rules.title: Title (`<h2>`). Receives `classNames.title`.
rules.subtitle: Subtitle. Receives `classNames.subtitle`.
rules.body: Body with its own scroll. Receives `classNames.body`.
rules.footer: Footer with the actions, aligned to the end. Receives `classNames.footer`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Modal has few variables of its own; the other colors and radii come from gem-system tokens, which you can redefine in a class (see Style changes). `--gem-modal-width` is set by the size classes, so use a selector like `.gem-modal.my-class` to change it.

items.--gem-modal-width: Max modal width. It never exceeds the viewport width minus 2rem. Does not apply with `size="full"`.
items.--gem-modal-radius: Radius when `rounded` is a number or a string. Written inline from that prop.

items.--gem-color-border: Modal border and header and footer separators.
items.--gem-radius-sm: Radius with `radius="sm"` and of the × button.
items.--gem-shadow-focus: Focus ring of the modal and the × button.
items.--gem-space-2: Gap between footer and header actions.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: Props of the Modal and its sections.

modal.title: Modal
modal.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of a `<dialog>`.

items.title: Header title. Also the accessible name.
items.subtitle: Secondary text under the title.
items.extra: Content at the end of the header, before the × button.
items.header: Free content inside the header. Combines with `title`, `subtitle` and `extra`.
items.radius: Radius from gem-system tokens, when there is no `rounded`.
items.rounded: Extra radius: `true` uses `--gem-radius-2xl`, a number is a percentage and a string is a CSS value.
items.showClose: Shows the × button in the header.
items.draggable: Lets the modal move by dragging the header.
items.initialFocusRef: Element that gets focus on open.
items.onOpenChange: Runs when the modal asks to open or close (Escape, backdrop, × button).

header.title: Modal.Header
header.description: Header for compound sections. It also accepts the HTML attributes of a `<header>`.

items.title: Title (`<h2>`).
items.subtitle: Secondary text under the title.
items.extra: Content at the end of the header.
items.close: Custom close control. The modal adds its × button after it.
items.children: Free content between the title and `extra`.

sections.title: Modal.Body and Modal.Footer
sections.description: They have no props of their own: they accept the HTML attributes of a `<div>` and a `<footer>`, including `className` and `children`.
